title: Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.30530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. translated_title: Assembly-JEPA：利用世界模型进行细粒度工业图像验证
translated_abstract: 由于显著的视觉变异性、标注缺陷数据的稀缺，以及许多装配错误本身的细粒度特性，工业装配过程的自动化验证仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有方法通常依赖于目标检测、CAD模型或监督式分类流程，这些方法难以在不断变化的产品和装配配置之间实现泛化。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的新型自监督装配验证框架。我们从基于JEPA的世界模型LeWorldModel出发，研究如何对该架构进行调整，以验证细粒度装配操作的正确性。为此，我们将装配验证表述为一个预测性世界建模任务，该任务基于装配过程的前后观测数据进行。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Assembly-JEPA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的自监督装配验证框架，将装配验证表述为基于装配过程前后观测的预测性世界建模任务，从而实现对细粒度工业装配错误的验证。
en_tdlr: Proposes Assembly-JEPA, a self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures that formulates assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task on before-and-after observations, enabling fine-grained industrial image verification.
